headline: Ferrari runs an HP blueprint-style livery in Austin
body: Ferrari has unveiled a one-off livery with title partner HP for the United States Grand Prix. Sketches and blueprint-style illustrations sit on the white engine cover and around the intake.

headline: Mercedes swaps silver for blue in Austin
body: Mercedes will run a one-off blue livery developed with MANUFAKTUR, the Mercedes-Benz personalisation programme. Russell will wear a vintage blue race suit and Antonelli a steel blue one. It is the team's second special livery in three races.
